errors.text: The hypothesis retains thermodynamic integration as the production method, whereas the target intervention replaces expensive TI with free energy perturbation using an MTP-to-DFT correction.
It omits the electronic free-energy and solid-state short-range-order contributions that materially shift the predicted melting temperature.
The claimed accuracy and throughput—±50 K, thousands of compositions in days, and specified percentage errors for entropy and heat capacity—are not supported by the cited evidence.
